hints.title: Apples in a Square of Radius R
hints.text: A square plot centered at the origin with half-side length r has a total perimeter of 8 * r.

hints.title: Closed Form Apple Summation
hints.text: The total count of apples collected inside and on the border of radius r is given by 2 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r + 1).

hints.title: Binary Searching the Minimum Radius
hints.text: Binary search for the smallest integer r such that 2 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r + 1) >= neededApples, then return 8 * r.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search over cubic polynomial closed form expression.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Incremental boundary expansion loop takes O(R) = 10^5 steps, while binary search resolves in ~20 steps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical summation eliminates coordinate grid iteration.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive or recognize the sum of coordinates for concentric squares and apply binary search.
